facts.statement: The Board has 12 members; all twelve are standing for re-election as the 2023 Director nominees, each to serve until the next Annual Meeting.

The Board determined that all current Directors other than Dr. Albert Bourla are independent: 11 independent Directors, namely Susan Desmond-Hellmann, Scott Gottlieb, Helen H. Hobbs, Susan Hockfield, Dan R. Littman, Suzanne Nora Johnson, Ronald E. Blaylock, Joseph J. Echevarria, Shantanu Narayen, James Quincey and James C. Smith; the determination relied on the Governance & Sustainability Committee report, including a review finding director-affiliated transactions below the Standards thresholds.

Dr. Albert Bourla is Chairman of the Board (since January 2020) and Chief Executive Officer (since January 2019); after a Governance & Sustainability Committee review in December 2022, the independent Directors unanimously determined to keep the combined Chairman and CEO role.
facts.stated_time: Chairman since January 2020; structure reaffirmed December 2022

facts.statement: Shantanu Narayen is the Lead Independent Director, a role held since 2018; the independent Directors re-elected him to the role in the December 2022 leadership review.
The independent Directors assessed Shantanu Narayen as well-qualified to continue serving as Lead Independent Director.

The independent Directors based keeping Dr. Bourla as Chairman and CEO on their belief that he has extensive biopharmaceutical industry and regulatory knowledge and the leadership and vision necessary to lead the Board.
The Board has five committees: Audit; Compensation; Governance & Sustainability; Regulatory and Compliance; Science and Technology.
Audit Committee: Chair Suzanne Nora Johnson; other members Ronald E. Blaylock, Joseph J. Echevarria and James C. Smith.
Compensation Committee: Chair James C. Smith; other members Ronald E. Blaylock and James Quincey.
Governance & Sustainability Committee: Chair Joseph J. Echevarria; other members Susan Desmond-Hellmann, Helen H. Hobbs and Dan R. Littman.
Regulatory and Compliance Committee: Chair Scott Gottlieb; other members Helen H. Hobbs, Susan Hockfield, Dan R. Littman and Suzanne Nora Johnson.
Science and Technology Committee: Chair Helen H. Hobbs; other members Susan Desmond-Hellmann, Scott Gottlieb, Susan Hockfield and Dan R. Littman.
There were no changes to Committee compositions in 2022.
All members of the Audit, Compensation, Governance & Sustainability, Regulatory and Compliance, and Science and Technology Committees are independent Directors.

No Compensation Committee member was or is an officer or employee of Pfizer, and no Pfizer executive officer served on the compensation committee or board of a company employing a member of the Pfizer Compensation Committee or Board.
facts.stated_time: During 2022 and as of the date of this Proxy Statement

facts.statement: All Audit Committee members are financially literate and qualify as Audit Committee Financial Experts.
All Compensation Committee members are non-employee directors as defined in Rule 16b-3 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.

Based on evaluations and review of the current Board composition, the Governance & Sustainability Committee and the Board determined the criteria for Board membership have been satisfied and believe each nominee brings a strong and unique set of perspectives, experiences and skills.

The Governance & Sustainability Committee assessed the qualifications of Directors for Committee service and their independence, and determined all Directors comply with the Corporate Governance Principles and have sufficient time, energy and attention to serve on the Board.
The Board did not elect any new Directors during 2022.
Pfizer has elected five new independent Directors to the Board since 2018.
Average Director tenure is seven years.
